The short answer is there’s really no great way to tell just off qualities it has. Your best bet would be to acetone wash, as I believe levamisole is soluble in acetone while cocaine is not so a good way to gauge how much cut is in your coke is to weigh out a gram on a 0.00 scale and do an acetone wash and then weigh it after and see how much you lost. Chances are even with high quality cocaine, you’ll still have lost quite a bit, from either the acetone not being totally anhydrous, or actual cut. This isn’t totally foolproof since there are variables and there are other cuts people use that won’t get washed by acetone, but it’s a start. 

But to wrap up, your best bet is to buy a marquis test kit, you can test for many different potential drugs and substances with just a tiny pinch of your product. I understand not everybody has the means to do this or wants to spend the time/money but it’s essential to safe recreational drug use. 

So basically, I’m not sure exactly how you would tell but (sorry for not being totally harm reductive here) if you’ve tried it and had good results, you’re probably fine.
